LanguageData.Bin_Large.description: A spacious waste disposal unit that efficiently keeps the surrounding area clean. Slowly removes trash and filth in a 15-cell radius.
LanguageData.Bin_Large.label: large bin
LanguageData.Bin_Small.description: A small bin to help keep the surrounding area somewhat clean. Slowly removes trash and filth in a 10-cell radius.
LanguageData.Bin_Small.label: small bin
LanguageData.Light_Streetlamp.description: An electrical standing lamp that lights an area, good for large outdoor spaces. Will automatically turn off during the day to prevent power consumption.
LanguageData.Light_Streetlamp.label: outdoor lamp
LanguageData.Misc_FileCabinet.description: Increases research speed when placed near a research bench. One research bench can use up to two filing cabinets.
LanguageData.Misc_FileCabinet.label: filing cabinet
LanguageData.Shelf_WeaponRack.description: A shelf for storing weapons. Items stored in this will not affect room beauty and they won't deteriorate, even if outside.
LanguageData.Shelf_WeaponRack.label: weapon rack
LanguageData.VFE_DeskLamp.description: An electrical desk lamp that lights a small area. People need light to move and work at full speed.
LanguageData.VFE_DeskLamp.label: desk lamp
LanguageData.VFE_FloorLamp.description: A low-profile light source embedded into the floor. While not as bright as a standing lamp, it provides subtle, even lighting without obstructing movement. Does not short circuit in rain.
LanguageData.VFE_FloorLamp.label: floor lamp
LanguageData.VFE_LongPlantPot.description: Plant decorative flowers here to improve the mood of people nearby. Designed to be combined with other plant pots to form various shapes.
LanguageData.VFE_LongPlantPot.label: long plant pot
